prompt: Why did the man use a second probe?
promptZh: 男子為什麼使用第二支探針？

options.text: To check whether the original display showed the correct air temperature
options.zh: 確認原本的顯示器是否顯示正確的空氣溫度
options.whyZh: 兩支探針不是放在同一處量同一種東西，試測不是要校正空氣讀值。

options.text: To measure how quickly the liquid chilled after being put into the freezer
options.zh: 測量測試液放進冰櫃後多快冷卻
options.whyZh: 要觀察的是開蓋時液體是否跟著空氣升溫，不是測新放入的液體冷卻要花多久。

options.text: To find which shelf had the lowest air temperature
options.zh: 找出哪一層架子的空氣溫度最低
options.whyZh: 第二支探針量液體，不是在不同層架量空氣作比較。

options.text: To see whether the liquid warmed as much as the air near the lid
options.zh: 觀察液體是否跟蓋子附近的空氣升溫一樣多
options.whyZh: 顯示器讀的是蓋旁空氣，另一支探針放在測試液裡，才能分開看兩種變化。

evidence: whether what's inside warms up as much as the air does. | The display measures air by the lid. | I put a second probe inside a sealed bottle of test liquid
